mathematics.assertion_tested: Pre-registered held-out test of conjecture C3 (formula frozen in exp_c3_small_subgroups.conjectured_dmin before this run): for 20 primes q not used in fitting, one fresh generic curve each, d_min(m) equals the C3 prediction for every m. Side check (not part of C3): agreement on CM curves D in {-3,-4,-7}.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: F_p exact (numpy int64 with p < 2^14, all products < 2^41; Python ints for polynomials and number theory)
mathematics.conventions: Relation Y*psi(X) + phi(X) = 0 with deg phi, deg psi <= d on all M=(q-1)/2 distinct pairs (x_k, x_{mk}); d_min(m) = least such d (exact rank over F_p, monotone in d, binary search); interpolation threshold d_int = least d with 2d+2 > M.
non_claims: Generic curves with q || N and |D_K| > 4q only; CM curves are a labelled side check

randomness.generator: Python random.Random (prime, curve and point selection)
